name: Nishiawakura (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Nishiawakura village emblem in white: an outlined triangle enclosing three smaller triangles, like a mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Nishiawakura, a village in Okayama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted in October 1924.

features.role: Nishiawakura village emblem — an outlined triangle enclosing three smaller triangles, like a mountain
